source.note: 1989 Topps Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles non-sport wax product. TCDB treats the flagship checklist as one 176-card set distributed in Series One (#1-88) and Series Two (#89-176). VCS combines both series into one collector-facing Base ProductSet with equal availability. The two 11-sticker wax-pack checklists are combined into one 22-card Stickers ProductSet because every physical pack contained one sticker. Factory-set-only Bonus Cards and Complete Collector's Edition issues are excluded from wax-pack gameplay.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 collectible cards per pack, 48 packs per box. Physical wax packs contained five base cards plus one sticker; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule, so the guaranteed sticker occupies one of the four VCS card slots.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-176 remains one VCS Base ProductSet. The physical Series One/Series Two split is retained only as subset metadata so completion and prestige track one 176-card set.
decisions.seriesCombination: Series One (#1-88) and Series Two (#89-176) are combined with equal Base availability. One Series One pack image should be used for the single VCS product pack type.
decisions.stickerModeling: The 11 Series One stickers and 11 Series Two stickers are combined into one 22-card Stickers ProductSet. Card numbers are namespaced S1-1 through S1-11 and S2-1 through S2-11 to preserve uniqueness. Because each physical pack included one sticker, oddsPerPack is 1.
decisions.nonSportMetadata: The display-facing Player field stores the card title or sticker subject. Team is populated with the franchise value 'Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles' so VCS retains complete metadata without inventing a sports team.
decisions.excludedRelatedSets: Bonus Cards are explicitly factory-set inserts. Complete Collector's Edition and Complete Collector's Edition Stickers are factory-set/parallel issues, not ordinary wax-pack outcomes, and are excluded.
decisions.errorHandling: TCDB currently lists no errors or variations for the flagship 176-card set, so no duplicate variant rows are modeled.
decisions.oddsPlacement: The guaranteed sticker rate is stored only on the Stickers ProductSet. No card Variant contains pack odds.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pack art, card images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-176, combining physical Series One (#1-88) and Series Two (#89-176) with equal VCS Base availability.

productSets.name: Stickers
productSets.notes: Combined wax-pack sticker checklist: 11 Series One stickers plus 11 Series Two stickers. Physical packs contained one sticker per pack; VCS card numbers use S1-/S2- prefixes to keep duplicate 1-11 numbering unique.
